blocks.text: Simcoe Addiction and Mental Health rehab provides kind, compassionate, evidence-based services for men and women struggling with substance use as well as co-occurring mental health conditions such as mood disorders, borderline personality disorder, PTSD, and more. Simcoe Rehab offers a full continuum of care including medical detox, residential treatment, a family program, specialty programs for first responders and veterans, and alumni aftercare services. Their holistic approach provides individualized treatment plan options. An abundance of programming along with self care options makes this facility truly unique.A typical week at Simcoe includes 4 individual therapy sessions weekly and 25 group therapy sessions that include skills groups, process groups, and trauma-based groups. Throughout the week, clients will have the opportunity to engage in weekly family therapy sessions, support groups, eye movement therapy (EMDR), recovery care, aqua therapy, nutritional education, yoga, and physical fitness.After finishing the Simcoe program, clients walk away with a wide array of valuable skills learned such as a sense of freedom, increased self esteem, forgiveness, increased energy levels, confidence, better physical health, and a brighter outlook on life. Simcoe doesn’t stop there, they go one step further by offering a life-time of aftercare services. Aftercare consists of weekly aftercare meetings that allow individuals the opportunity to connect on a regular basis.Simcoe Addiction and Mental Health is located in Cookstown, Canada. The facility has plenty of amenities for clients to enjoy. A beautiful pond is located at the front of the property, and there is plenty of space for walking or jogging around the facility. Clients can also enjoy a tennis court, a gym, a sauna, an indoor pool, a hot tub, and a fire pit. Simcoe’s well-rounded program combined with a luxurious setting makes this center a top-notch choice.

centre.about_html:
Simcoe Addiction and Mental Health rehab provides kind, compassionate, evidence-based services for men and women struggling with substance use as well as co-occurring mental health conditions such as mood disorders, borderline personality disorder, PTSD, and more. Simcoe Rehab offers a full continuum of care including medical detox, residential treatment, a family program, specialty programs for first responders and veterans, and alumni aftercare services. Their holistic approach provides individualized treatment plan options. An abundance of programming along with self care options makes this facility truly unique.
A typical week at Simcoe includes 4 individual therapy sessions weekly and 25 group therapy sessions that include skills groups, process groups, and trauma-based groups. Throughout the week, clients will have the opportunity to engage in weekly family therapy sessions, support groups, eye movement therapy (EMDR), recovery care, aqua therapy, nutritional education, yoga, and physical fitness.
After finishing the Simcoe program, clients walk away with a wide array of valuable skills learned such as a sense of freedom, increased self esteem, forgiveness, increased energy levels, confidence, better physical health, and a brighter outlook on life. Simcoe doesn’t stop there, they go one step further by offering a life-time of aftercare services. Aftercare consists of weekly aftercare meetings that allow individuals the opportunity to connect on a regular basis.
Simcoe Addiction and Mental Health is located in Cookstown, Canada. The facility has plenty of amenities for clients to enjoy. A beautiful pond is located at the front of the property, and there is plenty of space for walking or jogging around the facility. Clients can also enjoy a tennis court, a gym, a sauna, an indoor pool, a hot tub, and a fire pit. Simcoe’s well-rounded program combined with a luxurious setting makes this center a top-notch choice.

Simcoe Addiction And Mental Health - Center Overview

SAMH believes that healing from trauma and emotional pain requires more than just therapy. They provide four therapy sessions and groups per week, as well as time for reflection, fun, and relaxation. They believe that having fun is important in recovery and finding new activities can help the brain experience pleasure in a healthier way.

SAMH welcomes all approaches to recovery and understands that there is no one-size-fits-all solution. They use evidence-based therapeutic techniques like Cognitive Behavioural Therapy and Dialectical Behaviour Therapy to work with clients, and have experienced therapists, certified addiction counsellors, and nurses who provide medical support and assistance throughout the process.

raw_html:
Program Length

30–90 days

Cost

18,000–45,000 CAD

Simcoe Addiction and Mental Health rehab provides kind, compassionate, evidence-based services for men and women struggling with substance use as well as co-occurring mental health conditions such as mood disorders, borderline personality disorder, PTSD, and more. Simcoe Rehab offers a full continuum of care including medical detox, residential treatment, a family program, specialty programs for first responders and veterans, and alumni aftercare services. Their holistic approach provides individualized treatment plan options. An abundance of programming along with self care options makes this facility truly unique.
A typical week at Simcoe includes 4 individual therapy sessions weekly and 25 group therapy sessions that include skills groups, process groups, and trauma-based groups. Throughout the week, clients will have the opportunity to engage in weekly family therapy sessions, support groups, eye movement therapy (EMDR), recovery care, aqua therapy, nutritional education, yoga, and physical fitness.
After finishing the Simcoe program, clients walk away with a wide array of valuable skills learned such as a sense of freedom, increased self esteem, forgiveness, increased energy levels, confidence, better physical health, and a brighter outlook on life. Simcoe doesn’t stop there, they go one step further by offering a life-time of aftercare services. Aftercare consists of weekly aftercare meetings that allow individuals the opportunity to connect on a regular basis.
Simcoe Addiction and Mental Health is located in Cookstown, Canada. The facility has plenty of amenities for clients to enjoy. A beautiful pond is located at the front of the property, and there is plenty of space for walking or jogging around the facility. Clients can also enjoy a tennis court, a gym, a sauna, an indoor pool, a hot tub, and a fire pit. Simcoe’s well-rounded program combined with a luxurious setting makes this center a top-notch choice.

Simcoe Addiction And Mental Health - Center Overview

SAMH believes that healing from trauma and emotional pain requires more than just therapy. They provide four therapy sessions and groups per week, as well as time for reflection, fun, and relaxation. They believe that having fun is important in recovery and finding new activities can help the brain experience pleasure in a healthier way.

SAMH welcomes all approaches to recovery and understands that there is no one-size-fits-all solution. They use evidence-based therapeutic techniques like Cognitive Behavioural Therapy and Dialectical Behaviour Therapy to work with clients, and have experienced therapists, certified addiction counsellors, and nurses who provide medical support and assistance throughout the process.
